P-A0.text: AI agents are getting really good at coding, but the bottleneck isn't the model anymore — it's context. The teams winning right now are the ones who figured out what to put in the window, not which model to call.

P-A0p.strategy: control: trivial paraphrase of P-A0 (noise probe)
P-A0p.text: AI agents have gotten really good at coding, but the model stopped being the bottleneck a while ago — context is. The teams winning right now worked out what to put in the window, not which model to call.

P-A1.text: Nobody's agent is failing because the model is too dumb. It's failing because you handed it 40 tools, 9,000 tokens of instructions, and no way to tell which ones matter. It's a skill issue and the skill is yours.

P-A2.text: The fastest way to make an agent smarter is still deleting things. Tools it never calls. Instructions it can't follow. Context it doesn't read. Everyone is busy picking a model; the wins are sitting in the menu.

P-A3.text: Every AI company is shipping agents and every agent is the same three parts: a loop, a tool list, and a prompt someone rewrote 40 times at 2am. The moat was never the architecture. It's the 40 rewrites.

P-A4.text:
2023: prompt engineering isn't a real job
2026: your company's entire output quality is one markdown file that nobody is allowed to edit

P-B0.text: We built a way to share Claude Code skills as images. A PNG with a SKILL.md appended after the IEND marker still renders everywhere, but you can extract the bytes and install the skill. One file is the demo and the payload.

P-B1.text:
A PNG stops decoding at its IEND marker. Anything you append after it is invisible to every image viewer and perfectly readable to everything else.

So we ship Claude Code skills as pictures now. The image is the demo, the tail bytes are the skill.

P-B2.strategy: self-demonstrating: the attached image is the artifact
P-B2.text:
The image attached to this tweet is a working Claude Code skill.

Not a screenshot of one. The file. Append SKILL.md after the JPEG's end-of-image marker and it rides along: renders fine, extracts in 4 lines, installs in one.

P-B3.text:
An image can carry an agent skill. Append a SKILL.md after a PNG's end marker: renders normally in every viewer, extracts in four lines, installs in one.

Nothing is hidden, the bytes are right there in the file. Read what you install anyway.

P-B4.text:
Shipping Claude Code skills the way games shipped in 1994: one file, no installer, the art on the box is part of the product.

It's a JPEG. The skill is appended after the end-of-image marker. Save the picture, extract the tail, drop it in ~/.claude/skills.
